features.title: Rehearse a talk with a coach and clock
features.intro: Practice Studio is for rehearsing a talk before a set date. A coach reads your notes or deck, drafts the story for you to approve and plans the practice. Each rep is then timed while you speak.

items.name: Coach chat
items.text: Paste notes or drop a .pptx, .pdf, .md or .txt file, and give the event, time limit and date. The coach answers in the chat and updates the cards beside it.

items.name: Next rep
items.text: A card shows the next rep, with its number, drill, time limit and one instruction, and sometimes a tip below. A sample 3-minute demo is loaded, so Record works on the first visit.

items.name: Live rep
items.text: Record counts down and turns the screen dark. Depending on the drill, it shows the current beat and its time bar, a pace meter and the clock. Space or a tap starts the next beat.
